dataset: Fashionpedia official TRAIN split, stratified subset for rare labels
license_note: Fashionpedia annotations/ontology are CC BY 4.0. Image copyrights remain with original sources.
selection: greedy set cover targeting 800 samples per label with current train support < 800, restricted to image_id >= 15131 and excluding round-1 selection
correction_note: 원본은 build_train_csv.py 가 shards_used=[0,1] 과 selection 문구를 하드코딩해 2차 실행에도 1차 값이 그대로 기록됐다. shard 목록은 data/provenance/fashionpedia/shard_index.json 의 image_id→shard 색인으로 재계산했다.
